title: The Foundation of the Battery Age
subtitle: As the world shifts toward electric vehicles, lithium has become the most critical resource for achieving a carbon-neutral future.
byline: Adapted from reporting by Energy Correspondents, International Energy Agency and Department of Energy, 2024

summary.en: Lithium is essential for modern electric vehicle batteries and the global transition to clean energy. Demand for this 'white gold' is expected to rise significantly by 2030. This article explores why this metal is the cornerstone of our climate goals.
summary.zh: 鋰電池是現代電動車的核心，也是全球能源轉型的重要推手。這種被稱為「白金」的金屬需求預計在 2030 年前將大幅成長。本文將探討為何鋰金屬是達成氣候目標的基石。

paragraphs.en: According to the International Energy Agency’s 2024 Global EV Outlook report, the transition to clean energy is fundamentally changing global resource requirements. The report highlights that lithium is the most critical component in the batteries that power electric vehicles (EVs). Because of its unique ability to store and release energy efficiently, lithium has earned the nickname 'white gold' in industrial circles. As noted by the International Energy Agency, this metal is now the heartbeat of the transportation revolution, serving as the essential material that allows us to move away from fossil fuels and toward a more sustainable, electrified future for our planet.
paragraphs.zh: 根據國際能源署（IEA）2024 年發布的《全球電動車展望》報告，能源轉型正在從根本上改變全球對資源的需求。該報告強調，鋰是驅動電動車電池中最關鍵的成分。由於鋰具有高效儲存與釋放能量的獨特能力，在工業界被稱為「白金」。正如國際能源署所指出的，這種金屬現在是交通運輸革命的核心，作為一種關鍵材料，使我們能夠擺脫化石燃料，邁向更永續、更電氣化的地球未來。

paragraphs.en: The United States Department of Energy explains in its battery technology briefings that lithium-ion batteries are the gold standard for energy storage today. These batteries work by moving lithium ions between the anode and the cathode, a process that creates the electrical current necessary to run a vehicle. The Department of Energy reports that this chemical process is highly stable and capable of holding large amounts of energy in a relatively small package. This efficiency is exactly why lithium-ion technology is considered the primary tool for supporting carbon neutrality, as it enables vehicles to travel long distances without producing harmful tailpipe emissions.
paragraphs.zh: 美國能源部在其電池技術簡報中解釋，鋰離子電池是當今能源儲存的黃金標準。這些電池透過鋰離子在陽極與陰極之間的移動來運作，此過程產生了驅動車輛所需的電流。能源部報告指出，這種化學過程非常穩定，且能在相對較小的體積內儲存大量能量。這種效率正是為何鋰離子技術被視為支持碳中和的主要工具，因為它使車輛能夠在不產生有害尾氣排放的情況下行駛長距離。

paragraphs.en: A 2024 report by the International Energy Agency suggests that the demand for lithium will grow at an unprecedented rate over the next decade. As governments around the world implement stricter climate policies, the shift toward electric mobility is accelerating faster than previously anticipated. The International Energy Agency reports that to meet the goals of the Paris Agreement, the global supply chain must scale up significantly to handle the increased need for battery-grade lithium. This surge in demand is not just a trend but a structural change in how the global economy consumes raw materials for energy production.
paragraphs.zh: 國際能源署 2024 年的一份報告指出，鋰的需求在未來十年內將以史無前例的速度成長。隨著世界各國實施更嚴格的氣候政策，向電動交通的轉型速度比預期更快。國際能源署報告稱，為了達成《巴黎協定》的目標，全球供應鏈必須大幅擴張，以應對對電池級鋰日益增加的需求。這種需求的激增不僅是一種趨勢，更是全球經濟在能源生產原料消費方式上的一種結構性轉變。

paragraphs.en: Projections from the International Energy Agency indicate that by 2030, the demand for lithium could be many times higher than current levels. As noted in their latest market analysis, the massive expansion of EV manufacturing plants across Asia, Europe, and North America is the primary driver of this growth. The International Energy Agency reports that without a significant increase in mining and processing capacity, the world could face severe supply shortages. These supply constraints could potentially slow down the global adoption of electric vehicles, making the rapid development of new, sustainable lithium extraction projects a major priority for policymakers.
paragraphs.zh: 國際能源署的預測顯示，到 2030 年，鋰的需求量可能比目前水準高出數倍。正如其最新的市場分析所指出的，亞洲、歐洲與北美各地電動車製造廠的大規模擴張是此成長的主要推動力。國際能源署報告稱，如果沒有大幅提升採礦與加工能力，全球可能面臨嚴重的供應短缺。這些供應限制可能會減緩全球電動車的普及速度，因此，快速開發新的、永續的鋰提取計畫已成為決策者的一項重大優先事項。

paragraphs.en: Experts at the International Energy Agency emphasize that lithium is not just a commodity but a strategic asset for national energy security. According to the International Energy Agency, countries that control the supply of lithium will have a significant advantage in the future green economy. This is why many nations are now investing heavily in domestic mining and refining capabilities. The International Energy Agency reports that this race for resources is creating a new geopolitical landscape, where the security of battery supply chains is becoming just as important as traditional oil security was in the twentieth century.
paragraphs.zh: 國際能源署的專家強調，鋰不僅是一種商品，更是國家能源安全的戰略資產。根據國際能源署的說法，掌握鋰供應的國家將在未來的綠色經濟中擁有顯著優勢。這就是為什麼許多國家現在正大力投資國內的採礦與精煉能力。國際能源署報告稱，這種資源競賽正在創造一個新的地緣政治格局，其中電池供應鏈的安全正變得與二十世紀時的傳統石油安全一樣重要。

paragraphs.en: While the demand for lithium continues to climb, the International Energy Agency notes that the industry is also facing pressure to improve its environmental standards. According to the International Energy Agency, the extraction of lithium often involves large amounts of water and energy, which can impact local ecosystems. Therefore, the industry is looking for more sustainable ways to produce this 'white gold.' The International Energy Agency reports that new technologies are being developed to reduce the environmental footprint of lithium mining, ensuring that the transition to electric vehicles does not come at the cost of local environmental health.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管鋰的需求持續攀升，國際能源署指出，該產業也面臨提升環境標準的壓力。根據國際能源署的說法，鋰的提取通常涉及大量水與能源的使用，這可能會影響當地生態系統。因此，該產業正在尋找更永續的方式來生產這種「白金」。國際能源署報告稱，目前正在開發新技術以減少鋰礦開採的環境足跡，確保電動車的轉型不會以犧牲當地環境健康為代價。

paragraphs.en: In conclusion, the International Energy Agency maintains that lithium is the cornerstone of the modern battery age. As outlined by the International Energy Agency, the path to carbon neutrality is paved with the successful integration of lithium-ion technology into our daily lives. By 2030, the global demand for this metal will define the success of our climate goals. The International Energy Agency reports that the world must balance the urgent need for more lithium with the necessity of protecting our planet, making the next decade a defining period for the future of sustainable energy and global transportation.
paragraphs.zh: 總結來說，國際能源署堅持認為鋰是現代電池時代的基石。正如國際能源署所概述的，邁向碳中和的道路，是建立在將鋰離子技術成功整合進我們日常生活之中的基礎上。到 2030 年，全球對這種金屬的需求將決定我們氣候目標的成敗。國際能源署報告稱，世界必須在對鋰的迫切需求與保護地球的必要性之間取得平衡，這使得下一個十年成為永續能源與全球交通未來的關鍵時期。

options.C: Because it is mined in the same locations as gold.
options.D: Because it is a bright, shiny metal that reflects light.
